data.long_meaning: Murtaja is derived from the Arabic word 'Raja' which means 'hope'. A Murtaja is someone who provides support and helps others in achieving their hopes. The name Murtaja carries the meaning “Support, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murtaja usually hope their child will grow to embody support, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Murtaja is associated with the virtue of being supportive and helpful, embodying the spirit of mutual aid and cooperation.
data.etymology: Murtaja belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Support, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Murtaja total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
